reason: In packages/features/auth/lib/next-auth-options.ts:121-129 the password is checked only when `!credentials.totpCode`. The new branch at line 131 (`twoFactorEnabled && credentials.backupCode`) accepts a matching backup code and never checks totpCode, so the TOTP check at 157-186 is skipped. A valid backupCode plus any non-empty totpCode therefore logs the user in without a password check.
